name: musk-anatomie
description: Elon Musk : anatomie d'une fortune — documentaire motion design 3D isométrique (Hyperframes + Three.js)

scripts.render: npm run build && hyperframes render -o out/musk-anatomie.mp4
scripts.render:draft: npm run build && hyperframes render -q draft -o out/musk-anatomie-draft.mp4
scripts.lint:tiktok: npm run build && cd tiktok && hyperframes lint
scripts.check:tiktok: npm run build && cd tiktok && hyperframes check
scripts.dev:tiktok: npm run build && cd tiktok && hyperframes preview
scripts.render:tiktok: npm run build && cd tiktok && hyperframes render -o ../out/musk-anatomie-tiktok.mp4
scripts.lint:variants: npm run build && for d in . tiktok en tiktok-en; do (cd $d && hyperframes lint); done
scripts.check:tiktok-en: npm run build && cd tiktok-en && hyperframes check
scripts.dev:tiktok-en: npm run build && cd tiktok-en && hyperframes preview
scripts.render:en: npm run build && cd en && hyperframes render -o ../out/musk-anatomie-en.mp4
scripts.render:tiktok-en: npm run build && cd tiktok-en && hyperframes render -o ../out/musk-anatomie-tiktok-en.mp4
